about.head: About

intro.end: about Portal, their developer platform built on Backstage. My first thought was: hold on, with a monorepo this big, I can actually build one for my own stuff. So I did.
intro.start: The portal came later, after reading

about.lead: I'm Xifré Font, a senior frontend developer in Barcelona. Before that I was a lawyer, and founded Huella Legal while practising.

playground.detail: I wanted to see what a big monorepo really looks like: **Nx boundaries**, domain-driven design, **hexagonal adapters** for outside vendors like WordPress and the translation tool, and **a lint rule for every convention**, so nothing depends on someone remembering it.

tooling.detail: Then came the scripts, to speed up the work and the back-and-forth with AI. And the **decision records (ADRs)**, which I'm a bit proud of: every call has its reason written down, so nothing here is truly arbitrary. The tooling also **reports its own usage**. This way, an unused script gets cut instead of being mindlessly maintained.

workflows.detail: Building Huella Legal end to end taught me which steps come back on every project. I turned that into **workflow templates**, so the next rebuild, or the next site from scratch, starts from what already worked.

apps.detail: At some point it stopped being just a playground: it was good enough to grow **real apps** on. Huella Legal moved in, then Marina Roustan, and there are more to come.

lessons.all: Every workflow, in the developer view

answerFirst.paid: Build tickets were filed the night before the final design (#208). A newsletter provider was swapped after it was already wired in (#242 → #299).

blockedTicket.paid: Otherwise an agent could start from a plan that changed an hour ago. The pick command checks GitHub first and refuses.
blockedTicket.rule: A blocked ticket can't be picked.

hostDecision.paid: A hosting switch slipped in under a lint ticket and was reverted two days later (#377, #378).
hostDecision.rule: Changing host is its own decision.

realDeploy.paid: Four bugs only showed up once the site was deployed (#382, #387, #388, #395).
realDeploy.rule: Test deploy work on a real deploy.

unknownsFirst.paid: Hosting was picked on paper, then changed five times (#186, #244, #302, #377).
